hero_subhead: Leaks, boiler faults, or blocked drains — David Todd Plumbing gets to you fast, fixing it right first time.
services_subhead: From emergency leak repairs to full bathroom installations, David Todd Plumbing covers every plumbing need for Nottingham homeowners and landlords.

services.title: Emergency Leak Repairs
services.desc: Burst pipes and sudden leaks can cause serious damage fast. David Todd responds promptly across Nottingham to isolate and repair leaks before costly damage sets in.

services.title: Boiler Servicing & Repairs
services.desc: Keep your boiler running safely and efficiently with a professional annual service. Faults diagnosed and repaired quickly to restore your heating and hot water.

services.title: Bathroom Installations
services.desc: Full bathroom fitting from start to finish, including suite installation, tiling, and pipework. Quality finishes that stand the test of time.

services.title: Blocked Drains & Toilets
services.desc: Stubborn blockages cleared efficiently using the right tools for the job. Drains left flowing freely with minimal disruption to your home.

services.title: Central Heating Systems
services.desc: Installation, repair, and power flushing of central heating systems to maximise efficiency and reliability throughout the colder months.

services.title: Tap & Shower Repairs
services.desc: Dripping taps and faulty showers waste water and money. Fast, affordable repairs to stop the drip and restore proper water pressure.

about_pullquote: Every job I take on, I treat it as if it were my own home.
about_para_1: David Todd Plumbing was founded by David Todd, a fully trained and experienced plumber with over a decade of hands-on work across Nottingham and the surrounding areas. Built on a foundation of honest advice, fair pricing, and quality craftsmanship, the business has grown through word-of-mouth recommendation from satisfied local customers.
about_para_2: David takes real pride in being a plumber Nottingham residents can rely on — arriving when promised, explaining the work clearly, and leaving your home tidy once the job is done. Whether it's a small repair or a full installation, you'll always deal directly with David, ensuring a personal and professional service every time.
reviews_heading: What Nottingham Homeowners Say About David Todd Plumbing

reviews.text: David came out the same day I called about a burst pipe under the kitchen sink. Sorted it quickly, explained exactly what he'd done, and the price was very fair. Wouldn't hesitate to recommend him to anyone in Nottingham.
reviews.author: Karen B.

reviews.text: Really impressed with the service. Boiler had stopped working on one of the coldest nights of the year and David was there within a couple of hours. Friendly, professional, and got us back up and running the same evening.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Used David for a full bathroom refit and the finish was brilliant. He kept us updated throughout, tidied up after himself every day, and the whole job came in on budget. Absolutely top-notch tradesman.
reviews.author: Sophie R.
